canonical_identity.title: Barkhaa Audio — Mundari-language Level 1 resources
canonical_identity.provider: Central Institute of Educational Technology (CIET), NCERT
canonical_identity.provider_parent: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)

scope.basis: The official CIET Barkhaa Audio index explicitly labels Mundari versions for multiple Level 1 titles.

deduplication.canonicalization_rule: Treat the CIET Barkhaa index as one collection identity; individual audio manifestations remain child resources until their direct media locators and metadata are verified. Do not count language labels or titles as separate source identities.

evidence_promotion.reason: The official index establishes collection/title/language identity, but direct audio bytes, immutable media locators, hashes, transcript alignment and item-level reuse terms were not yet verified.

rights_access_consent_cultural_review.access: Official public CIET index is discoverable.
rights_access_consent_cultural_review.rights: Do not infer redistribution or derivative-data permission from public playback/indexing; item-level terms require verification.
rights_access_consent_cultural_review.consent: Speaker/translator/performer consent and contributor provenance are not established by the index and remain unresolved.
rights_access_consent_cultural_review.cultural_uncertainty: No cultural proposition is inferred from a story title, audio label or educational context. Sensitive/community-governed content status remains unassessed.

blocked_or_pending: Resolve direct media URLs for each Mundari-labelled item.
Record immutable bytes and SHA-256 where lawful and technically obtainable.
Verify duration, codec, speaker/translator/performer credits and transcript availability.
Verify item-level reuse/license terms and attribution requirements.
Review contributor consent/provenance and cultural-access constraints before evidence promotion.
controlled_metrics_policy: Do not increment MMSC/evidence/module/publication counts from this locator audit until deterministic WEB-MUN reconciliation establishes whether this collection is a genuinely new canonical identity and downstream controlled artifacts are regenerated.
release_effect: Explicit audited locator/gap improvement only; does not by itself change the release gate.
